narrative.overview: The site uses supplied brand artwork and real field photography, with authentic technical photographs providing visual proof of the company's work. Spacious editorial typography and layered deep blue surfaces give the images room, while the cyan call action stays immediately recognizable. Spanish and English share the same composition.
rules: The homepage WhatsApp disclosure opens upward over the hero copy without changing hero height, with viewport-bounded internal scrolling, a sticky close control, Escape/outside-pointer dismissal, and focus restoration from the close control.
dos: Do use the supplied commercial HVAC artwork in the homepage hero and retain authentic technical photographs elsewhere, including the existing van asset and business/social imagery.
Do keep a direct call action visible on every page.
Do preserve bilingual page parity and local content facts.
donts: Don't add invented statistics, testimonials, or geographic landing pages.
